product_name: GitHub Copilot · VS Code suggestions and chat

scope.experience: Assistive inline completions and code chat inside VS Code
scope.task: Request an explanation of a function, accept or reject code suggestions, and manually review and test the resulting change.
scope.configuration: VS Code with Copilot suggestions and chat; no agent mode or autonomous command execution. No specific model, license or repository was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: A developer or learner who understands code and an IDE

conversational.rationale: The assessed experience combines open natural-language code chat with non-conversational inline suggestions inside an editor.
conversational.uncertainty: Using only chat or only completions would change the interaction profile.

specialization.rationale: Software development is a clear professional task domain with codebase context, code suggestions and developer-specific workflows.
specialization.uncertainty: Broad programming-language support does not imply expert performance in every language or repository.

autonomy.rationale: The tool prepares code and explanations using context, while users review and apply suggestions and control testing or publication.
autonomy.uncertainty: This assistive profile excludes agent modes that can edit multiple files or run commands independently.

accessibility.rationale: Integration with an existing editor reduces friction for developers, but understanding code and configuring an IDE are significant prerequisites.
accessibility.uncertainty: License, organization policy, supported clients and programming skills constrain use; this is audience breadth, not an accessibility audit.

explainability.rationale: Suggestions are concrete code users can inspect, and code chat can provide explanations, but generated rationales and context selection are not fully accountable.
explainability.uncertainty: Source inspection and tests remain necessary; code explanations do not certify correctness or faithful model reasoning.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: GitHub Copilot assistive VS Code suggestions and chat without agent mode, cloud tasks or autonomous commands. Scores are design estimates. Source: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/what-is-github-copilot .
